package.description: A feature-rich environment for writing LaTeX documents on Windows

en-US.description: A feature-rich environment for writing LaTeX documents on Windows
en-US.longDescription: TeXnicCenter is what we call an integrated documentation environment (IDE) for LaTeX. That means that TeXnicCenter integrates all the functionality you need to create, write, build, fix, view and print your LaTeX documents. TeXnicCenter’s innovative user interface, its powerful features, its large community (more than 1,000,000 users all over the world) and the fact that it is Free Open Source Software (GPL) makes it the first choice for LaTeX authors working on the Windows platform.
en-US.name: TeXnicCenter

zh-CN.description: Windows 平台上功能丰富的 LaTeX 文档编写环境
zh-CN.longDescription: TeXnicCenter 是我们所称的 LaTeX 集成文档环境（IDE）。这意味着 TeXnicCenter 整合了创建、编写、构建、修正、查看和打印 LaTeX 文档所需的所有功能。凭借其创新的用户界面、强大的特性、庞大的全球用户社区（超过 1,000,000 用户）以及作为自由开源软件（GPL）的身份，TeXnicCenter 已成为 Windows 平台上 LaTeX 作者的首选工具。
